row: Dr Umer Pain Relief & Chiropractic Care

Welcome to Dr. Umer Fayyaz's Pain Relief & Chiropractic Care, a haven for individuals seeking holistic pain management and chiropractic solutions. Dr. Umer, an esteemed practitioner with over 20 years of experience, specializes in a myriad of manual therapies, including Osteopathic and Chiropractic techniques acquired from iThrust Italy. With a Master’s degree in Neuro Musculoskeletal, he further honed his skills with international certifications in Dry Needling, KinesioTaping, Cyriax Orthopedic Medicine, and Mulligan Manual Concepts. Our clinic prides itself on a personalized approach, utilizing a comprehensive range of treatments like trigger point therapy, joint mobilization and manipulation, dry needling, postural correction, Kinesio taping, spinal adjustment, and body alignment to achieve exceptional clinical outcomes for musculoskeletal conditions. Join us on a journey to optimal health and wellness, where patient care is our top priority.
